home.title: Physiotherapy in the Plateau-Mont-Royal
home.intro: Assessment, treatment, and sports or post-surgery rehabilitation with a team of six physiotherapists.
home.hoursText: Choose your service, your physiotherapist and a time that suits you.

availability.title: Availability
availability.noSlots: No availability this week. Try another week or another physiotherapist.
availability.rescheduling: Choose the new time for your appointment.

status.error: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

footer.fictional: Student project: fictional clinic and data.

account.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 30 minutes. Also check your spam folder.

reset.title: New password
reset.rules: At least 12 characters, without your email address. A phrase of several words is easy to remember.
reset.tooShort: The password must have at least 12 characters.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
reset.weak: The password must not contain your email address.
reset.invalid: This link is no longer valid (it was already used or it has expired).
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can now log in. For your security, all your open sessions were closed.

verify.title: Email address confirmation
verify.done: Your email address is confirmed. You can now log in.
verify.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.

login.title: Log in
login.unverified: First confirm your email address with the link you received.
login.codeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.invalidCode: Incorrect code. Try again with the code shown now.
login.mfaSetup: First staff login: set up two-step verification in the desktop app first.
login.setupIntro: First login: open your authenticator app (Microsoft or Google Authenticator), add an account and scan this code. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
login.qrAlt: QR code to scan with the authenticator app
login.manualKey: Or type this key by hand:

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: We only ask for what is needed for your appointments.
register.comms: I agree to receive electronic communications (optional).
register.sent: Account created. Open the link we emailed you to confirm your address, then log in.
register.invalid: Check the fields: some information is not valid.
register.ageHint: Online accounts are for people aged 14 or more. For a younger child, the parent or tutor calls the clinic.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.rule: Free cancellation more than 24 hours before: the deposit is refunded. Less than 24 hours before, it is kept.
book.heldUntil: This time is reserved for you until {{time}}.
book.testCard: Test mode: use the card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date and any code.
book.taken: This time was just taken. Please choose another one.
book.evaluation: A first treatment needs an initial evaluation. Please book an evaluation first.
book.late: Less than 24 hours before the appointment, it can no longer be changed online. Please call the clinic.
book.paymentsOff: Online payment is not available right now. Please call the clinic.
book.missing: No time selected. Go back to the availability page.

done.confirmed: Your appointment on {{day}} at {{time}} with {{name}} is confirmed. See you soon!
done.waiting: Thank you! We are waiting for Stripe's confirmation, it takes a few seconds…
done.slow: The confirmation is taking longer than expected. Your appointment will show as confirmed in “My appointments” as soon as it arrives.

mine.title: My appointments
mine.confirmRefund: Cancel this appointment? It is more than 24 hours before: your deposit will be refunded.
mine.confirmFee: Cancel this appointment? It is less than 24 hours before: the deposit will be kept as a fee.
mine.cancelledRefund: Appointment cancelled. Your deposit will be refunded to your card.
mine.cannotCancel: This appointment can no longer be cancelled online. Please call the clinic.
mine.refundFailed: The refund could not be made right now, so nothing was cancelled. Please try again in a few minutes.
mine.lateHint: Less than 24 hours before: to change it, please call the clinic.

workspace.title: Therapist workspace
workspace.name: Name
workspace.notFound: File not found: you can only open the files of patients you treat.
workspace.audited: Every opening of this file is recorded in the audit log.
workspace.emptyNote: Fill in at least one part of the note.
workspace.signWarning: Once signed, the note can never be changed again. A correction will be an amendment.

chat.title: Practical questions
chat.notice: Automated assistant: I answer practical questions from the clinic’s documents. No medical advice. Emergency: 911. Do not share health information.
chat.hint: Examples: Where can I park? How do I cancel an appointment? Does insurance cover it?
chat.label: Your question
chat.error: The service is temporarily unavailable. Call the front desk at 514-555-0100.
chat.tooMany: Too many questions in a short time. Try again in a minute.

services.intro: A service is never deleted: once deactivated it disappears from booking, and appointments already booked stay.
services.name: Service
services.initial: Initial evaluation (required for a first visit)
services.badMoney: Enter the amounts in dollars, for example 95.00.
services.depositTooHigh: The deposit cannot be more than the price.

staff.intro: The new member receives an email link to choose their password, then sets up their 6-digit code at the first login. You never see their password.
staff.invitationHint: The link is valid for 72 hours and works only once.
staff.created: Account created. An invitation was sent to {{email}}.
staff.invitationSent: New invitation sent to {{email}}. The old link no longer works.
staff.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{email}}'s account? Their sessions will be closed at once.
staff.confirmDeactivateWithAppointments: {{email}} has {{count}} upcoming appointments, which the front desk will need to move. Deactivate the account and close their sessions?
staff.photoFor: Photo of {{name}} (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 3 MB or less)
staff.photoType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
staff.photoSize: The photo must be 3 MB or less.
staff.photoSaved: Photo of {{name}} saved. It appears on the Our team page.
staff.photoRefused: This image was refused. Try another photo.

audit.intro: Who opened or changed what, when and from which app. Entries can never be changed or deleted, and this reading is itself recorded.
audit.unusualHint: In red: access refused, or more than 10 different patients opened by the same person in one hour. Click a patient's name to see every access to their file.

privacy.intro: Patients' requests (Law 25). Answer within 30 days: late requests are in red. The patient receives the answer by email.
privacy.eraseHint: Closes the account, erases contact details and withdraws consents. The health record is kept until the end of its retention period, with the reason written in the answer.
privacy.confirmErase: Close {{name}}'s account and erase their contact details? This cannot be undone.

incidents.intro: Confidentiality incident register (Law 25). Entries are kept at least 5 years and cannot be deleted. An incident with a risk of serious injury must be reported to the Commission d'accès à l'information and to the people concerned.
incidents.discovered_at: Date the clinic learned about it
incidents.toNotify: Notifications to make: risk of serious injury.

reports.intro: Report for the week (Monday to Sunday). Counts and totals only: no patient names.
reports.definitions: Occupancy: booked time (confirmed, seen, no-shows) divided by working hours minus time off. No-show rate: no-shows divided by expected patients. Revenue: money received during the week, minus refunds.

myExercises.title: My exercises
myExercises.none: You have no exercise program in progress. Your physiotherapist can give you one at an appointment.
myExercises.dose: {{sets}} sets of {{reps}} reps, {{times}} times a week
myExercises.alreadyDone: This exercise is already checked off today.

myData.title: My data
myData.intro: Law 25 lets you see, correct or delete the personal information the clinic keeps about you. The clinic answers within 30 days.
myData.what: What do you want to do?

types.deletion: Delete my account and my information

myData.deletionHint: Your account will be closed and your contact details erased. The health record is kept 5 years after the last visit, as the professional order requires, then anonymized.
myData.noHealth: Do not write health information here.
myData.sent: Request sent. You will receive the answer by email and here.
myData.alreadyOpen: You already have an open request of this type.
myData.dates: Asked on {{asked}} · answer by {{due}} at the latest

receipts.title: My receipts
receipts.intro: Receipts for your past visits, for your insurer.
receipts.failed: The receipt could not be downloaded. Please try again.

consents.title: My consents
consents.policyNew: The policy has changed (version {{version}}). Read it, then accept it to keep using your account.
consents.policyHint: It is needed to have an account. To stop all use of your information, ask for your account to be deleted above.
consents.commsGiven: You agreed to receive reminders and clinic news since {{date}}.
consents.commsWithdrawn: Withdrawn on {{date}}: you no longer receive reminders or news.
consents.commsNever: You have not given this consent: you receive no reminders or news.
consents.commsHint: Necessary messages (booking confirmation, password, answer to a request) are sent in every case.
consents.loadError: Your consents cannot be shown right now.

hours.title: My hours and time off
hours.intro: Patients can book only during your working hours, outside your time off. Montréal time.
hours.noHours: No working hours: nobody can book with you.
hours.invalid: Check the hours: the start must be before the end, with no overlap on the same day.
hours.reasonHint: For example "training" or "vacation". Do not write health information.
hours.added: Time off added: these hours are no longer offered to patients.
hours.invalidTimeOff: Check the dates: the start must be before the end.
